Generates a comprehensive report to drive system improvement lifecycle and

focus.



Runs on a cadence and can optionally trigger remediation and adaptive

scheduler-cadence tuning.



Generate improvement report

zqk system improvement-report

Generate JSON report without remediation triggers

zqk system improvement-report --format json --trigger-remediation=false

Usage:
  zqk system improvement-report [flags]

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
